dishes.name: Allgäu Kässpatzen
dishes.desc: Egg noodles layered with mountain cheese and topped with fried onions. The most typical dish of the Allgäu, found in every inn in Kempten.

dishes.name: Kemptener Krautkrapfen
dishes.desc: Egg-dough pockets filled with sauerkraut, bacon and butter, then baked or fried. A traditional Kempten dish.

dishes.name: Allgäu mountain cheese
dishes.desc: Hard, aged cow's-milk cheese from Alpine dairies, nutty and firm. Kempten has a long tradition of cheese ripening.

dishes.name: Flädlesuppe
dishes.desc: Clear beef broth with thin strips of pancake and chives. A classic first course on Allgäu menus.

dishes.name: Topfenschmarrn
dishes.desc: Torn, fluffy curd-cheese pancake, usually served with fruit compote or ice cream. A regular on Allgäu menus after hiking.
